themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, manage workflows, and interact with data or systems to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content related to AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code, often acting as intelligent coding partners.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms designed to aid researchers in various stages of the research process, from literature review to data analysis and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: AI applications that condense large amounts of text, such as articles, reports, or user feedback, into concise summaries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: AI-generated personas or simulated users used for testing, training, or research purposes, often replicating human behavior or characteristics.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: The use of AI in understanding and impacting job markets, hiring processes, and the skills required for future employment.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Leveraging AI to analyze customer data, feedback, and behavior to derive actionable insights for product and service improvement.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Integrated platforms that offer a suite of AI tools and capabilities specifically designed for conducting and managing research.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Applications of AI that assist product managers in tasks such as market analysis, roadmap planning, feature prioritization, and user feedback analysis.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: The application of AI in understanding design trends, user preferences, and the creation of new design elements and systems.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
